note: Hand-written confidence overrides and delineation notes per control point (the automatic part compares the area with the official CEDEX bracket).

poyo-ribarroja.note: Placed where the OSM A-3 motorway crosses the flow path (39.4738, -0.5833); the SAIH gauge is assumed to be at that bridge (gauge coordinate itself UNVERIFIED). 183 km2 here vs 187 km2 published.

poyo-torrent.note: Just below the Horteta junction (Torrent / Picanya limit).

poyo-paiporta.note: Channel catchment is well defined, but in extreme floods the Poyo overflows upstream (A-3 / A-7 corridor, Torrent) and water also reaches Paiporta and the neighbouring towns overland.

poyo-catarroja.note: Flat l'Horta Sud: channel is artificial below Paiporta and overbank flow spreads towards Massanassa, Alfafar, Sedaví and Benetússer; the published 430-480 km2 'at the Albufera' includes lateral areas that do not pass this channel section.

saleta-aldaia.note: Flat urban plain, culverted/artificial channels: the Saleta and the Pozalet (official 51.8 km2) merge and disperse through Aldaia, Alaquàs and Xirivella; drainage partly follows irrigation canals towards the new Turia channel.

picassent-beniparrell.note: Flat terrain near the Albufera; channel partly artificial below the A-7 / V-31.

carraixet-alfara.note: Lower Carraixet crosses l'Horta Nord in a channelised bed; small plain tributaries (Palmaret) are uncertain.

turia-nuevo-cauce.note: New Turia channel (Plan Sur). Unregulated scope is what matters here (below Benagéber-Loriguilla-Buseo).

magro-utiel.note: Utiel-Requena plateau: very flat headwaters with small closed depressions (CEDEX closed basin 200220, 27 km2, excluded).

magro-requena.note: Utiel-Requena plateau: flat headwaters, see magro-utiel.

magro-algemesi.note: Lower Magro runs perched across the Ribera plain; overbank flow leaves the channel towards Algemesí / Guadassuar.

verd-alzira.note: Ribera plain: Riu Verd collects ravines and springs between Alberic, Massalavés and Guadassuar; plain part of the divide is uncertain.

jucar-alzira.note: Natural catchment excludes the official closed basins of La Mancha (about 1,600 km2; the official 21,578 km2 includes them). The lower Júcar is perched: floodplain flow does not follow the channel.

jucar-sueca.note: See jucar-alzira. Ribera Baixa is a perched-channel flood plain.

casella-alzira.note: Several short ravines (Casella, Vila, Estret, Fosc) converge on Alzira; the DEM-derived junctions differ from the official network, total for the group is 43-48 km2.

canyoles-canals.note: The Almansa corridor (CEDEX closed basin 200180, 622 km2) is treated as endorheic following the official subcatchment layer; an unburned DEM would spill it into the Cànyoles.

vaca-tavernes.note: Lower valley is a flat marsh (la Valldigna); karst headwaters.

gallinera-oliva.note: Karst valley: a large share of ordinary runoff infiltrates; the channel reaches the Pego-Oliva marsh.

girona-verger.note: Karst headwaters; Isbert dam never holds water (no regulation).

gorgos-xabia.note: Karst catchment with strongly influent channel between Xaló and Gata.

sec-borriana.note: Plana de Castelló: channel crosses the citrus plain in an artificial bed; Onda (Benitandús) dam, about 1 hm3, ignored.

sec-castello.note: Urban canalised reach; the official 99 km2 refers to the whole basin at the sea, including plain areas that join below the town.

millars-vilareal.note: Below the Rambla de la Viuda junction.

viuda-almassora.note: María Cristina (18 hm3 for 1,400 km2 = 13 mm) is not considered regulating in scope 1; it is in scope 2.

chinchilla-orpesa.note: Small coastal catchment, no official reference found for this section.

coves-alcala.note: Highly permeable karst basin (Rambla de Sant Miquel): large area, low runoff yield in ordinary events.

juncaret-alacant.note: Urbanised plain (Sant Joan / Mutxamel huerta), canalised channel.

monnegre-campello.note: Tibi (4 hm3, silted) is not regulating in scope 1.

vinalopo-elda.note: Upper Vinalopó: Villena lagoon (drained by the Acequia del Rey) is included, Salinas lagoon (73 km2) and the Almansa-Caudete closed basins are excluded as endorheic following CEDEX. Flat, partly endorheic terrain.

vinalopo-elx.note: See vinalopo-elda. Elx reservoir is silted (no regulation in scope 1). Official 1,692 km2 includes endorheic parts.

abanilla-benferri.note: Outside the Júcar demarcation (no official reference available here); most of the catchment is in Murcia. Below Benferri the rambla has no channel to the Segura: it spreads over the Vega Baja.

segura-orihuela.note: Mostly outside the Riuà box (see inside_box_fraction): rainfall on the missing part is not seen by the model. Heavily regulated basin with many flood-control dams and an artificial channel; endorheic areas from HydroSHEDS sinks (Yecla) excluded. Treat the natural scope as indicative only.

seco-pilar.note: Outside the Júcar demarcation, no official reference area found.

ovejas-alacant.note: Area matches the official CEDEX basin 2001916 (196.4 km2).
